why: I checked both briefs against must_not item 1, which bars PASS/FAIL conditions stricter than the issue's lines. The verifier brief breaks it in three places. Item 6 makes the verdict depend on a branch-name rule ("branch name matches CLAUDE.md convention (<type>/<issue>-<slug>, no claude/ prefix, under 60 chars)"). It also limits which files the PR may touch ("the diff is limited to this tool plus README/lock changes"). Item 4 adds a mutation test ("mutate lint() ... break line numbering, and confirm a test would fail"). None of these is in expect lines 4 or 6. The builder brief also says "Branch name must match <type>/<issue>-<slug>", so the same stricter rule appears there too. On item 2, the behaviour checks hold up: the verifier runs the CLI on real files instead of only reading the diff. Even so, the extra conditions break the criterion.
